description: This file defines an interface for remote connection management within the WPEFramework RPC namespace. It includes nested notification interfaces, method signatures for connection handling, and iterator type definitions.

classes.name: IRemoteConnection
classes.description: An interface for managing remote connections, providing methods for acquiring interfaces, termination, launching, and posting mortem reports.

classes.name: IRemoteConnection::INotification
classes.description: A nested interface for handling remote connection notifications such as activation, deactivation, and termination events.

classes.name: IStringIterator
classes.description: An iterator type for strings, based on IIteratorType.

classes.name: IValueIterator
classes.description: An iterator type for uint32_t values, based on IIteratorType.

methods.name: REQUESTEDINTERFACE * Acquire(const uint32_t waitTime,const string & className,const uint32_t version)
methods.description: Template method to acquire a specific interface type from the remote connection with wait time, class name, and version parameters.

methods.name: Id
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the remote connection.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Method to acquire an interface pointer based on interface ID and wait time.

methods.name: Launch
methods.description: Launches the remote connection, returning a status code.

methods.name: PostMortem
methods.description: Posts a post-mortem report for the remote connection.

ctags.name: Acquire
ctags.pattern: /^            REQUESTEDINTERFACE* Acquire(const uint32_t waitTime, const string& className, const /
ctags.signature: (const uint32_t waitTime,const string & className,const uint32_t version)

ctags.name: INotification
ctags.pattern: /^            struct EXTERNAL INotification : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/

ctags.name: IRemoteConnection
ctags.pattern: /^        struct EXTERNAL IRemoteConnection : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
